type.provenance: Provides that on and after specified dates, no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State specified products that contain intentionally added PFAS chemicals.

who.provenance: no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any product...; a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in this State

action.provenance: Provides that on and after specified dates, no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State specified products that contain intentionally added PFAS chemicals.

products.provenance: the following product categories if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical: (1) Carpets or rugs. (2) Fabric treatments. (3) Food packaging. (4) Juvenile products. (5) Oil and gas products. (6) Apparel. (7) Cosmetics. (8) Indoor textile furnishings. (9) Indoor upholstered furniture. (10) Outdoor textile furnishings. (11) Outdoor upholstered furniture.

value: Cookware that meets certain size and labeling requirements
exceptions.provenance: Cookware is exempt from this Section if it meets all of the following requirements: (1) The surface area of the cookware is not large enough for a product label that meets the requirements to be affixed to the item. (2) The cookware does not have any of the following: (A) An exterior container or wrapper upon which a product label can appear or be affixed. (B) A tag or label to which information about the cookware may be attached.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The regulation does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'

intentionally_added.provenance: The regulation specifically refers to 'intentionally added PFAS chemicals'
